confirmation_reference.aggregation: saved cell means, equal configurations within seed, then three-seed mean/sample SD; separate from main comparison

summary.statistics: Ten scene means per training model; equal-weight mean and sample SD over three model seeds. Reward differences paired by model/configuration/scene.

definitions.pressure_grouping: Within configuration/model, tertiles of physical-decision-step pressure across ten scenes; np.searchsorted(side=right), thresholds/ties/counts saved. Group read means pool live receiver decisions within model; three model means receive equal weight.
definitions.weighted_read_size: alpha_r * ||u_r||_2; descriptive vector magnitude, not marginal reward or signed output contribution.
definitions.weighted_read_fraction: alpha_r ||u_r|| / sum_j alpha_j ||u_j||, calculated per live receiver before averaging; vector cancellation and learned projection excluded.
definitions.event_time: pre-action state.step=t; next physical transition is t+1. Damage uses exact adjacent target cumulative-damage differences or an immediate terminal summary; unknown tails after all defenders die are excluded. First damage uses saved first_damage_step_by_target; blue removal uses agents_destroyed events at t+1.
definitions.blue_removal: Decrease in live blue count on the next physical transition; not synonymous with interception. Exact interception is episode_summary.blue_deaths_by_cause.intercepted / initial N_B.
definitions.defender_variation: Mean within-state population SD across live receiver alpha; temporal SD across state means within episode, then equal episode average.
definitions.same_defender_adjacent_step_change: Within each episode, mean absolute alpha difference for the same surviving defender on consecutive physical steps, pooling valid receiver-step pairs; ten episode means receive equal weight within model, then three models receive equal weight. Not a temporal SD.
definitions.event_association: Factual conditional description only; pressure/time/population composition and policy outcomes jointly vary. No attention/norm-to-reward causal claim.

combined_interventions.statistics: closed-loop differences paired by scene within model seed; same-state rates pool live factual decisions within model seed; equal mean and sample SD across three model seeds
combined_interventions.control: each arm uses the local standard from its own source run; formal performance tables unchanged

margin_analysis.legal_action_basis: HAD features.available_actions: every live entity has all nine planar actions; deceased rows excluded. Saved standard and L2 greedy decisions also checked.
margin_analysis.margin: largest minus second-largest standard Q among nine legal actions
margin_analysis.stability_certificate: margin > 2 * max(abs(Q_L2 - Q_L4)); sufficient for same-state greedy stability, not necessary and not a closed-loop guarantee
margin_analysis.lowest_decile: within configuration/model seed, margin <= np.quantile(margin, 0.1), including threshold ties
margin_analysis.statistics: pool active decisions within each model/configuration's ten scenes; across three model seeds report equal-weight mean and sample SD, not a pooled-decision uncertainty estimate

read_diagnostics.statistics: live-decision averages within configuration/model seed; equal mean and sample SD across three seeds
read_diagnostics.projection_difference: norm of W_f times (learned L4 fusion minus normalized first-two fusion); common bias cancels

formal.scope: formal 300 episodes per training seed and configuration
formal.first_damage_time_definition: minimum non-null target time; no damage assigned 100 only for restricted-time mean and never counted as a CDF event

evaluation.fixed_fusion: Within each model, average factual alpha over live decisions within configuration, then weight three configurations equally. Same existing diagnostic pool; no reward fitting or held-out claim.
evaluation.loop_bypass: Read original H0 tokens, retain self query, learned read attention, projection including bias, local host, and downstream GRU; four contextual updates removed.
evaluation.same_state: Reuse standard inputs and incoming hidden state; restore outgoing hidden/cached Q and RNG after two counterfactual forwards.
